title: Generalist vs Specialist Time Series Foundation Models: Investigating Potential Emergent Behaviors in Assessing Human Health Using PPG Signals
description: Across a broad PPG benchmark, MOMENT offers stronger classification and regression domain transfer, while PPG-GPT wins more regression comparisons after adaptation, with neither consistently outperforming simple clinical baselines. English two-host technical deep dive (NotebookLM). Paper: Saurabh Kataria et al., arXiv:2510.14254v1 — https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.14254v1
